Officially they say mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with someone in Pakistan isn't enough to keep him locked up, and it was allegedly just telephonic contact with this Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri.”

This is textbook coordinated damage control by the hidden elites. They weaponize these laws to manufacture threats and control the public whenever it suits their agenda, but had to release him anyway because the accusations were a fabricated distraction from the start. The real cross-border connections are being protected so their manipulations don't get exposed.
